headline: Get Dazmand
title: How to Get Dazmand | Pomegg Second Branch | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Pomegg has a secret second evolution. At level twenty five a normal Pomegg becomes Pomawk. But if you have a Roar Stone, it can become Dazmand instead. Each Pomegg can only take one branch, so a Pomegg that turns into Pomawk can never become Dazmand later. Raise two Pomegg if you want both. Pomawk or Dazmand? Comment below!
description: Pomegg evolves at level 25: into Pomawk, or into Dazmand with a Roar Stone. Each Pomegg can only take one branch.
